h2: Pool Repair Bali – Leaks, Loose Tiles & Pipework Sorted Out
intro: A dripping pool shell or a patch of lifting mosaic quietly drains your water bill and can weaken the villa structure over time. As a Pool Repair Bali specialist working across Canggu, Ubud, Seminyak, Uluwatu, Sanur, Jimbaran, Kuta, Legian, Nusa Dua, Denpasar, Kerobokan and Umalas, I focus on finding the real source before anything gets patched over.

sections.h3: Why Bali Villa Pools Start Failing After 15–20 Years
sections.text: Many villas across Canggu, Ubud, Seminyak, Uluwatu, Sanur, Jimbaran, Kuta, Legian, Nusa Dua, Denpasar, Kerobokan and Umalas were built with pools that are now 15–20 years old. Tropical heat, constant UV exposure and humidity accelerate grout breakdown, while salt-laden air near coastal areas corrodes copper and steel pipework faster than expected. Loose mosaic tiles, hairline cracks in the shell, and slow overnight water loss are usually the first signs that something underneath needs attention before it becomes a structural issue.

sections.h3: What a Typical Pool Repair Job Covers
sections.text: A standard visit starts with locating the exact source — whether that's a cracked tile joint, a failed gasket on a return line, or a pinhole in the skimmer plumbing. From there I replace affected mosaic or ceramic tiles, re-grout the surrounding area with pool-rated material, and repair or swap out leaking pipe sections. If the problem is more complex, such as a crack running through the plaster, I'll walk you through your options so you can decide what to tackle first rather than committing to a full resurfacing.

sections.h3: How to Prepare Before I Arrive – What to Send on WhatsApp
sections.text: Before booking, snap a few clear photos of the affected area — loose tiles, discoloured grout lines, or any visible weeping from the shell — and send them over WhatsApp along with a short note on how long you've noticed the issue and whether the water level drops overnight. That's usually enough for me to give you a realistic sense of scope and cost. If access to the pump room or under-villa plumbing is tricky, mention it in the same message so I can bring the right fittings and tools.

sections.h3: Small Habits That Keep Your Pool Shell Healthy Longer
sections.text: The cheapest repair is the one you never need. Check your water level every few days; a steady drop beyond normal evaporation points to a leak worth investigating early. Keep the pool filled — running it dry for weeks lets the shell crack as it dries out. Wipe down tile edges after heavy rain, and if you spot a single loose mosaic piece, get it re-set before its neighbours follow. Small, timely fixes save villa managers and owners from far larger plaster or structural work down the road.

faq.q: How do I know if my pool is actually leaking?
faq.a: If the water level drops more than a few millimetres per day beyond normal evaporation — especially when the pump is off — there's likely a leak in the shell or pipework that needs proper detection rather than just topping up.

faq.q: Do you handle both tile work and plumbing repairs on the same visit?
faq.a: Yes. Loose mosaic replacement, re-grouting, pipe gasket swaps and skimmer-line fixes are all part of what I cover, so most jobs don't require a second call-out.

faq.q: Which areas around Bali do you service?
faq.a: I travel across Canggu, Ubud, Seminyak, Uluwatu, Sanur, Jimbaran, Kuta & Legian, Nusa Dua, Denpasar, Kerobokan and Umalas, so most villa locations are within reach.
